gallery.artist:

gallery.description: A group of Soldiers with the Florida National Guard’s Chemical Biological Radiological Nuclear Emergency Response Force-Package inflate a zodiac boat used in the rescue operations of civilians during disasters such as Hurricane Irma. (Photo by Staff Sgt. Carmen Fleischmann)
